title: Hakuna Matata Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Seaside, Florida- Hakuna Matata cottage, with a prime location and expansive porches up and down! Located across from the Westside Seaside pool and a short walking distance just 8 homes to the beach in Seaside!
description_expanded: Description111 GRAYTON STREETQUEEN, QUEEN, BUNK ROOM (1 Bunk, twin over full with a trundle, sleeps 4)Welcome to No Worries in Seaside, FloridaTrue to its name, No Worries invites you to slow down, unplug, and settle fully into vacation mode. From the moment you step onto the expansive front porch—lined with inviting rocking chairs—you’ll feel the pace shift. Nearly every room in the home opens onto either the front porch or the second-floor balcony, creating a constant connection to fresh air, coastal light, and the reminder that you’re officially on vacation in Seaside, Florida.Relaxed Living with Space to GatherInside, the home opens to a spacious, family-friendly living room designed for together time. A large flat-screen TV anchors the space, while a thoughtfully curated library wall filled with books and games makes it easy to unwind or entertain. A table for four offers flexibility for casual meals, puzzles, or game nights after a day at the beach. Just beyond the centrally located staircase—open to the kitchen for an easy, connected feel—you’ll find a generous kitchen and dining area with seating for six, ideal for shared meals and relaxed conversation.Bright Kitchen Designed for Easy Vacation LivingThe kitchen features granite countertops and a large central cooking island with a built-in cooktop and oven, making it both functional and welcoming. Whether you’re preparing breakfast before heading to the beach or enjoying a home-cooked dinner, the layout is designed for effortless vacation living. A convenient half bath is also located on the first floor for guests.Comfortable Bedrooms for Rest and RechargeAll three bedrooms are located upstairs, offering privacy and quiet at the end of the day. The cheerful queen primary suite is filled with coastal charm and beach-inspired touches, complete with a private en-suite bathroom featuring a tub and shower combination. The second queen bedroom overlooks the West Side Pool just across the street, offering peaceful views and a prime Seaside location. The third bedroom is a colorful, kid-friendly retreat with plenty of space to sleep and play, featuring a twin-over-full bunk bed with a trundle—comfortably sleeping three.A Carefree Seaside EscapeWith welcoming outdoor spaces, a layout designed for connection, and a location that puts you steps from Seaside’s favorite amenities, No Worries is the perfect home base for a relaxed coastal getaway. Whether you’re rocking on the porch, gathering around the kitchen island, or making memories by the beach and pool, this charming Seaside cottage lets you truly leave your worries behind.If you need more room you can also rent KARIBU, the guest cottage that adds a bedroom and living area and sleeps up to 4. Rent these together and you’ll have a wonderful teen suite or grandparents suite that makes this property a perfect vacation home for your family.*5-night Spring Break, Spring & Fall; 2-night Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registrationFEATURES1,870 square feetPrivate Seaside residential beach at Odessa Pavilion176 yards | 2-minute walk to beach accessAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities provided2 parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homesGolf cart policy: A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002171
